module: Flowgraph node "Reset Crawl" (category once_instant, crawl). Resets the active crawl: teleports the vehicle to the start and resets data and timers. The system stays active but the timer is stopped until Start Crawl. Outputs: success, failed, isActive.

work.desc: Calls bridge.resetCrawl(). Success: isActive true; failure: isActive = bridge.isCrawlActive().
